title: The Festival Poster Problem
learning_focus: Visual purpose, stereotypes, audience, persuasive language, fact-based opinion, formal/informal tone, and non-verbal cues.
story_premise: A regional celebration poster attracts attention but uses inaccurate images and a slogan that speaks for everyone. The Pathfinder redesigns it with the organizing council.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Visual purpose, stereotypes, audience, persuasive language, fact-based opinion, formal/informal tone, and non-verbal cues.
